description: Curated inspiring quotes for the PomoDone dashboard. Every entry must belong to one of the three topics below — nothing off-topic goes in this file.

quotes.q: The two most powerful warriors are patience and time.
Lost time is never found again.
Time is what we want most, but what we use worst.
Until we can manage time, we can manage nothing else.
Don't watch the clock; do what it does. Keep going.
The bad news is time flies. The good news is you're the pilot.
You may delay, but time will not.
Time is the most valuable thing a man can spend.
Ordinary people think merely of spending time. Great people think of using it.
How we spend our days is, of course, how we spend our lives.
The future depends on what you do today.
A man who dares to waste one hour of time has not discovered the value of life.
Better three hours too soon than a minute too late.
Time is the coin of your life. You spend it. Do not allow others to spend it for you.
Yesterday is gone. Tomorrow has not yet come. We have only today.
Time is the wisest counsellor of all.
Time and tide wait for no man.
The key is not to prioritize what's on your schedule, but to schedule your priorities.
Either you run the day or the day runs you.
Time is free, but it's priceless. You can't own it, but you can use it.
Nothing is a waste of time if you use the experience wisely.
You will never find time for anything. If you want time, you must make it.
Someday is not a day of the week.
Take care of the minutes and the hours will take care of themselves.
Determine never to be idle. No person will have occasion to complain of the want of time who never loses any.
One always has time enough, if one will apply it well.
The most efficient way to live reasonably is every morning to make a plan of one's day.
Time flies over us, but leaves its shadow behind.
Punctuality is the thief of time.
All great achievements require time.
Do not wait; the time will never be just right.
Time is more valuable than money. You can get more money, but you cannot get more time.
To choose time is to save time.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
Success usually comes to those who are too busy to be looking for it.
Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value.
Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.
The difference between ordinary and extraordinary is that little extra.
The secret of success is constancy of purpose.
Success is walking from failure to failure with no loss of enthusiasm.
I never dreamed about success. I worked for it.
Action is the foundational key to all success.
Success seems to be connected with action. Successful people keep moving.
The road to success and the road to failure are almost exactly the same.
Don't be afraid to give up the good to go for the great.
If you really look closely, most overnight successes took a long time.
Success is liking yourself, liking what you do, and liking how you do it.
The only place where success comes before work is in the dictionary.
Success is not how high you have climbed, but how you make a positive difference to the world.
Success is not the key to happiness. Happiness is the key to success.
The secret of success is to do the common things uncommonly well.
Success is a science; if you have the conditions, you get the result.
There is no success without hardship.
Success is the child of audacity.
To succeed in life, you need two things: ignorance and confidence.
The successful warrior is the average man, with laser-like focus.
Success is how high you bounce when you hit bottom.
Don't aim for success if you want it; just do what you love and believe in, and it will come naturally.
Success is not measured by what you accomplish, but by the opposition you have encountered.
Failure is the condiment that gives success its flavor.
The ladder of success is never crowded at the top.
Success is doing ordinary things extraordinarily well.
Success is often achieved by those who don't know that failure is inevitable.
The distance between insanity and genius is measured only by success.
Success comes from knowing that you did your best to become the best that you are capable of becoming.
There are no secrets to success. It is the result of preparation, hard work, and learning from failure.
Hard work beats talent when talent doesn't work hard.
There is no substitute for hard work.
Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
Opportunities are usually disguised as hard work, so most people don't recognize them.
Nothing will work unless you do.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
I'm a great believer in luck, and I find the harder I work the more I have of it.
Far and away the best prize that life has to offer is the chance to work hard at work worth doing.
Without labor nothing prospers.
What separates the talented individual from the successful one is a lot of hard work.
Work hard, be kind, and amazing things will happen.
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
Diligence is the mother of good fortune.
Success is no accident. It is hard work, perseverance, learning and sacrifice.
Perseverance is not a long race; it is many short races one after the other.
Amateurs sit and wait for inspiration, the rest of us just get up and go to work.
Opportunity is missed by most people because it is dressed in overalls and looks like work.
Hard work spotlights the character of people: some turn up their sleeves, some turn up their noses, and some don't turn up at all.
Nothing in the world is worth having or worth doing unless it means effort.
If people knew how hard I had to work to gain my mastery, it would not seem so wonderful at all.
The harder I work, the luckier I get.
Persistence and resilience only come from having been given the chance to work through difficult problems.
Continuous effort — not strength or intelligence — is the key to unlocking our potential.
Hard work without talent is a shame, but talent without hard work is a tragedy.
Do the hard jobs first. The easy jobs will take care of themselves.
Whatever your life's work is, do it well.
Working hard for something we don't care about is called stress; working hard for something we love is called passion.
Inspiration is for amateurs. The rest of us just show up and get to work.
Efforts and courage are not enough without purpose and direction.
The only thing that overcomes hard luck is hard work.
Every job is a self-portrait of the person who did it. Autograph your work with excellence.
Pleasure in the job puts perfection in the work.
Nothing ever comes to one that is worth having except as a result of hard work.
